profile.headline: VP Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
OBJECTIVE 

             To attain a challenging position in dynamic and growing organization in which i can  utilize my expertise.

Specialties: • 4 years of strong experience in design and development of customized application using Oracle, Core Java, Swing, XML and Web services. I have good knowledge of JSP, Servlet, Spring, Hibernate and Struts.

Direct interaction with customer, understanding the requirement and responding with technical design and development is one of my key areas of working.

Worked directly with customers at their site (on-site) in Dubai (3 Months) and UK (4 Months) for better understanding and assisting in UAT, SIT and issues resolution.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Basking Ridge, New Jersey, United States
positions.description: Skills: Azure Databricks · Reliability · DevOps · Java · Site Reliability Engineering · Team Management · Mentoring · Project Planning · Project Estimation
